findings.title: Container image not digest-pinned: node:24
findings.why_suspicious: Mutable tags can be repointed upstream.
findings.remediation: Pin the image by digest (image@sha256:...) so the same bytes are used every build, and update the digest deliberately.

findings.title: 7 CI actions not SHA-pinned
findings.why_suspicious: Tag-pinned actions can be changed by their owners.
findings.remediation: Review the action's source, pin it to a full commit SHA, and give the workflow the minimum token permissions it needs.

findings.title: 6 dependencies declare install scripts
findings.why_suspicious: Inventory of packages that execute code at install time (review list).
findings.remediation: Do not install until reviewed. Read the script, remove it if it downloads or runs remote code, and install with --ignore-scripts in CI.
